config.prompt: Locate every adult butterfly and moth in the image, including small moths. Do not include caterpillars, pupae, other insects, flowers or leaves. Return only a JSON array: [{"bbox_format": "xyxy", "box": [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]}]. Coordinates must be integers from 0 to 1000, relative to the whole image. Use tight bounding boxes covering the entire visible insect. Return [] if none are present.
